tools.name: search_treatment_centers
tools.description: Find licensed drug and alcohol rehab centers, detox, methadone/MAT clinics, sober living homes and residential mental health programs in the U.S. by state and optionally city, level of care, payment option or special program. Data from SAMHSA FindTreatment.gov and Oxford House. Returns listing pages

tools.name: get_treatment_center
tools.description: Full details for one listing: address, phone, website, levels of care, payment accepted, programs, accreditation and the page URL. Pass the listing URL or slug from search results.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: Without arguments, lists states covered with facility counts. With a state, lists its cities with counts and directory URLs.
